Pretty printing

Source: R/printing-pretty.R
pretty.Rd

pretty(e) lays an expression out in two dimensions, as SymPy's pretty(): raised exponents, fractions over a bar, root signs and tall parentheses, in Unicode or ASCII. pprint() and pretty_print() print it. pprint_use_unicode(flag) sets the default and returns the previous value; pprint_try_use_unicode() turns Unicode on when the session encoding is UTF-8. pager_print() shows the result in the pager.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'sym'
pretty(x, use_unicode = NULL, ...)

pprint(e, use_unicode = NULL)

pretty_print(e, use_unicode = NULL)

pprint_use_unicode(flag = NULL)

pprint_try_use_unicode()

pager_print(e, use_unicode = NULL)

Arguments

use_unicode

Unicode or ASCII; the session default when NULL.

...

Unused.

e, x

An expression.

flag

TRUE, FALSE, or NULL to only query.

Value

A character scalar; the printing functions return NULL invisibly.

Examples

x <- Symbol("x"); y <- Symbol("y")
cat(pretty((x + 1)/(y - 2), use_unicode = FALSE), "\n")
#> x + 1
#> -----
#> y - 2 
pprint(sqrt(x^2 + 1), use_unicode = FALSE)
#>    ________
#>   /  2     
#> \/  x  + 1
